name: MarkerHighlight
description: Sentence in which chosen words or phrases receive hand-drawn marker strokes that sweep in one after another, each slightly skewed and rotated with organic rounded ends, as a full highlighter band or a low underline.
a11yNotes: The sentence is real text and the highlighted phrases are wrapped in semantic <mark> elements; the ink strokes are aria-hidden decoration. Adjacent punctuation stays glued to the marked phrase so it never wraps alone. Under prefers-reduced-motion the markers are shown fully drawn with no transition.

defaultProps.text: Great interfaces feel effortless, intentional, and quietly alive.

propsApi.default: 'Great interfaces feel effortless, intentional, and quietly alive.'

propsApi.name: highlight
propsApi.description: Words or phrases inside text that get a marker stroke (case-insensitive, first match each).

propsApi.name: textColor
propsApi.description: Sentence color (defaults to the theme foreground).

propsApi.name: thickness
propsApi.description: Marker style: a full highlighter band or a low underline stroke.

propsApi.name: duration
propsApi.description: Duration of each marker sweep in seconds.

propsApi.name: stagger

propsApi.name: delay
propsApi.description: Delay before the first marker sweeps, in seconds.
